title: Add P2-006 validator to final-head CI
businessObjective: Ensure each P2-006 merge candidate executes its static data-governance validator without granting CI or the contract data authority.
technicalObjective: Add one fixed GitHub Actions step for the already admitted P2-006 validator and document its bounded final-head assurance; do not change P2-006 product artifacts or add generic command execution.
assumptions: GOV-051 admits the exact P2-006 literal.
P2-006 is independently verified but unmerged.
No data, provider, storage, retention action, external service, or production operation is authorized.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow invokes exactly `node tests/data-governance/validate-data-minimisation-retention-contract-v1.mjs` after fast verification.
No generic/dynamic command, shell, credentials, external service, deployment, or product change is added.
Policy documents that final-head CI proves only the static P2-006 merge candidate and performs no data or retention operation.
Packet checks, independent Sol review, evidence, and final-head CI pass.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-GOV-052 --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
solEscalationTriggers: Any generic/dynamic CI execution, data/storage/retention behavior, external service, credential, deployment, or P2-006 product change requires a separate packet.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only fixed CI step, policy statement, GOV-052 packet/evidence/risk; preserve P2-006 and terminal history.
